title: Ledger event envelope (one per JSONL line)

seq.description: 1-based, strictly increasing. The verifier rejects gaps and duplicates.

payload.description: Type-specific body: finding/ruling/recommendation payloads validate against their own schemas; 'problem' carries {statement, sources[]}; 'vote' carries {round, role, topic, stance}; 'charter' carries the locked charter.

role.description: Who produced this event ('engine' for deterministic events).

model.description: Model id if an LLM produced it; null for engine events.

prev_hash.description: sha256 of the previous event's canonical JSON (sorted keys, compact separators). Genesis event: 64 zeros. The verifier recomputes the chain; any rewrite breaks it (design law 3 made checkable).
